integrity: Two independent exact incidence constructions, direct finite orbit counts, binary boundary ranks and a complete online recurrence; all included, with explicit depth-five witness.
scientific_limitations: The classification is finite and specific to GQ(2,2); homology is computed only over F_2. No integral homology, homotopy or general GQ classification claimed; independent audit absent.
source_ids: Bishnoi, Finite Geometry and Ramsey Theory, online minicourse 2021-01-11, Example 3.3
title: Two-line unions in the doily: exact static and online shattering, facets, and homology
